import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert flipper_length_mm from text to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (row 10 has 4000000, which is invalid)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    
    # Fix label variants in island
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Fix label variants in sex
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Drop rows with invalid body_mass_g (NaN or out of range)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df


def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    
    # Return as dict with species as keys
    return result
